officialTitle: Osimertinib after Chemoradiotherapy in Stage III EGFR-Mutated NSCLC

design.blinding: Double-blind, placebo-controlled; PFS by blinded independent central review
design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: A total of 216 patients who had undergone chemoradiotherapy were randomly assigned to receive osimertinib (143 patients) or placebo (73 patients).

clinicalQuestion: Does maintenance osimertinib after chemoradiotherapy improve PFS in unresectable stage III EGFR-mutated NSCLC?

pico.population: Unresectable EGFR-mutated stage III NSCLC without progression during or after chemoradiotherapy

publications.title: Osimertinib after Chemoradiotherapy in Stage III-Mutated NSCLC.
publications.label: Primary PFS analysis

outcomes.endpointLabel: PFS by blinded independent central review
outcomes.sourceQuote: the median progression-free survival was 39.1 months with osimertinib versus 5.6 months with placebo, with a hazard ratio for disease progression or death of 0.16 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.10 to 0.24; P<0.001).
The percentage of patients who were alive and progression free at 12 months was 74% (95% CI, 65 to 80) with osimertinib and 22% (95% CI, 13 to 32) with placebo.

Interim overall survival data (maturity, 20%) showed 36-month overall survival among 84% of patients with osimertinib (95% CI, 75 to 89) and 74% with placebo (95% CI, 57 to 85), with a hazard ratio for death of 0.81 (95% CI, 0.42 to 1.56; P = 0.53).

safety.description: Adverse events of grade 3 or higher
safety.sourceQuote: The incidence of adverse events of grade 3 or higher was 35% in the osimertinib group and 12% in the placebo group
radiation pneumonitis (majority grade, 1 to 2) was reported in 48% and 38%, respectively.

strengths: Very large PFS effect in a biomarker-defined population
limitations: Placebo crossover/subsequent osimertinib may confound OS

clinicalImplications.text: Supports osimertinib consolidation after chemoradiotherapy for unresectable stage III EGFR-mutated NSCLC, making EGFR testing mandatory before choosing consolidation therapy in stage III disease.

tumourBoardPearl.text: In unresectable stage III disease, check EGFR before defaulting to PACIFIC-style durvalumab — LAURA defines a separate consolidation pathway for EGFR-mutant tumours.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 38828946. PubMed metadata strips italicised gene symbols from titles; officialTitle restores 'EGFR' based on abstract context.
